first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: Foreground person wearing a gray, wide-brimmed steel helmet, a tan-brown sleeveless outer layer, and an olive uniform, with a diagonal strap across the chest.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The person behind and following Person A, wearing a gray, wide-brimmed steel helmet and a relatively high collar, with a light-brown diagonal strap visible over a tan-brown outer layer.

entities.name: trench wall
entities.identification: The reinforced walls on both sides of the passageway, composed of wooden planks, upright posts, exposed earthen walls, and sections of corrugated metal sheeting, excluding the sky, the sandbags atop the wall, and the mound of earth.

entities.name: brown sandbags atop the wall
entities.identification: Tan-brown elongated rounded bag-like objects stacked horizontally in layers atop the wall behind the people.

entities.name: exposed mound of earth atop the wall
entities.identification: The brown, rough earthen surface visible above and behind the sandbags atop the background wall.

entities.name: grayish-white sky
entities.identification: A small patch of grayish-white sky within the opening above the outline of the wall top.

entities.name: trench cable
entities.identification: Multiple thin, dark lines hanging along the wall, gathered at attachment points and sagging downward, recorded in groups according to their visible regions.

entities.name: soldier's long gun
entities.identification: The upper portion of a slender, dark long gun visible vertically behind Person A's shoulder on the image-left side.
